data.reason_zh: 摘要明确优化工作流分解与分配，并由执行中成本反馈纠错；但未明确修改保留至后续任务，持久性存疑。

scope_support.feedback_quote: During execution, InFlowOp corrects a fault with the cheapest move via the same cost that serves the workflow both as it is built and as it runs.
scope_support.object_quote: Before execution, InFlowOp bidirectionally determines the granularity of task decomposition and agent assignment following from the cost rather than from a fixed template.
